request: Owner 2026-11-18: card face numbers are black by default, including everything the character carries outside the fight (attributes, gear, level, the global multipliers). A number is green only when something in the fight raises it (a status, the current stance's bonus, a triggered relic or card effect) and red only when something in the fight lowers it (Weak, Frail, ...). The baseline is the same card's face outside combat.
success: In a Reaver's opening hand of Strike, Sweep and Counter at 1280x800 and 390x844, Strike's damage is green (its Attack stance bonus) and Sweep's damage is plain black (only the always-on STR bonus), with no console errors. The red case (Weak on a Sweep) is pinned by tests/card-face-colours-2026-11-18.test.mjs, since the sandbox cannot apply a status.
failure: Sweep's damage is green or red although only attributes and the global multipliers apply to it; no figure is green on Strike; or the page logs a console error.
